references.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: one high-resolution transparent 2D Xiangqi game-piece sprite, first reference for an original contemporary Celadon collection.
Primary request: Exactly ONE Chinese chess red general disc. Its only character is precisely the traditional Chinese character "帥", upright, centered, large, bold and beautifully balanced with correct stroke anatomy. NOT the simplified 帅. Deep dark vermilion enamel fills genuinely recessed character strokes. Native printed character clarity matters more than ornament.
Physical design: an expertly made pale celadon glazed stoneware disc, about 44 mm diameter and 12.8 mm thick. Perfectly round top view. A quiet narrow rolled outer lip, a small stepped shoulder, and a single fine incised circular border in the same vermilion surround a broad flat readable face. The glyph fills about 62 percent of the disc diameter. Each recess has a crisp minute ceramic edge and enamel below the face. No raised decal. No metal rim, gold, dragon, landscape, maker's seal or extra character. This is a new contemporary game set, not a claimed historical artifact.
Material: very pale jade-grey celadon glaze with soft milky depth, barely visible restrained glaze pooling near the incised ring, subtle microscopic fired surface variation. Gentle satin-gloss highlights, not glassy transparency, plastic or heavy crackle. The body is the same pale colour across both players; the ink identifies the red side.
Composition: strict top-down orthographic product view, no camera tilt, no rotation. One whole centered circular piece fills about 82 percent of a square image, with generous clean transparent margin on every side. True transparent alpha background. No board, table, pedestal, cast floor shadow, checkerboard, labels or second view.
Lighting: neutral soft upper-left studio key with gentle fill, clear natural material detail and crisp silhouette, no harsh bloom or dramatic shadow hiding the character. Photographic realism suitable for a luxury tabletop game.
Output: one isolated finished piece, square high-resolution transparent PNG. Only "帥" and one plain circular face border.

Edit the supplied Celadon Xiangqi red-general sprite only to finish the cutout cleanly. Preserve exactly its centered upright traditional character 帥, recessed vermilion lettering and ring, pale celadon glaze, lighting and disc design. Remove all stray white/grey flecks, chips of background, fringe and isolated pixels outside the true round ceramic silhouette. The outer edge must be a smooth, intact circular contour with natural antialiased alpha, no ragged halo and no detached artifacts. Everything outside that circle must be genuinely transparent, with no shadow, background, checkerboard or added material. Keep the whole disc visible with clean transparent margin, square high resolution. Do not alter the glyph or replace the ceramic with a flat graphic.
